## Key Enterprise Projects
1. Skills-Training Exam Platform (بخش آزمون پلتفرم مهارت‌آموزی فنی و حرفه‌ای)
   - Role: Project Manager
   - Details: Led the architectural design and full delivery of the high-concurrency online examination module for the National Technical and Vocational Skills-Training Platform.
   - Technologies: Angular, .NET Core, SQL Server, Clean Architecture, Scrum.

2. Moghan Agro-Industry Comprehensive Financial System (سامانه مالی کشت و صنعت و دامپروری مغان)
   - Role: Project Manager
   - Details: Managed end-to-end development of the integrated financial and accounting system for Moghan Agro-Industry & Livestock Co., one of the country's largest agro-industrial complexes.
   - Technologies: .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, Stimulsoft Reports, Financial Modules.

3. Warehouse Management System — Oil Products Distribution Co. (سامانه انبارداری شرکت فرآورده‌های نفتی)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer
   - Details: Engineered inventory tracking, material movement, automated stock auditing, and reporting modules for an oil products distribution enterprise.
   - Technologies: C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, RESTful API, Stimulsoft Reports.

4. Employment Administration System (سامانه اداره استخدامی)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer
   - Details: Developed core modules, administrative workflows, and sensitive applicant screening pipelines for a governmental recruitment authority.
   - Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, C# .NET, SQL Server.

5. "Training 500 Young & Efficient Managers" Examination System (آزمون طرح تربیت ۵۰۰ مدیر جوان و کارآمد)
   - Role: Project Manager
   - Details: Managed the nationwide large-scale online examination process, high-concurrency test taking, score analysis, and competency assessment.
   - Technologies: Project Management, Angular, .NET Core, SQL Server, High Concurrency.
